mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate at the time of signal generation predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and increase equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals economic deterioration, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and construction activity support corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint signal (HOUST and RSAFS both rising) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (as indicated by rising CPI), higher inflation expectations lead to reduced equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during periods when CPIAUCSL is rising above 3.0% annually, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 signals a weakening manufacturing sector, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds from reduced output.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of retail sales (RSAFS) at the time of signal generation predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as strong consumer spending supports corporate revenue growth and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS is above its 75th percentile, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as corporate hiring supports economic growth and earnings.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases over 5 days, or the Rank IC for the interaction term over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 5.0% signals robust residential construction activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the housing sector's contribution to GDP growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST rises > 5.0% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
